# @tansy/forms

Contact forms and other forms for tansy: built from field blocks, kept as submissions, emailed to you, and guarded against spam.

```bash
npm install @tansy/forms
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the forms plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/forms.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
